---
name: odee-start
description: "Start the approved ODEE development/testing loop with the project manager, feature specialists and independent expert QA."
agent: odee-coordinator
---

Read [the operating guide](../../docs/agents.md) and
[roadmap](../../docs/roadmap/README.md). Establish the current baseline without
disturbing dirty work, initialize/reconcile the local task ledger, and honor the
shared control root. Dispatch bounded ready work using available actual
subagents, at most three feature workers and two testers. Continue
plan/build/challenge/adapt/fix/retest/integrate across approved ready tickets.
No releases or live business actions. Persist checkpoints and report blockers
honestly rather than simulating a permanent daemon.
